fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-06-17 (evening, 18:35): The complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 45,000 was debited instead. Contact details given by the complainant, Sanjay Raj, include the number 9000000083. Rajesh Rajan (9000000302) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Gopal Mani (mobile 9000000457) was named as a possible person of interest. The complaint refers to Murugan Sundaram, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000207. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100041. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots, transaction records and digital documents.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Transaction record; Digital document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, associate, witness, receiving account, mobile number, suspect, college road
